data.body:
Fix pushed for review as Gerrit change 2976 (Change-Id Ifcadc4a1bc17bf6a5cd71fc4d7706c115bc2f671), branched from origin/main e5293bf5b14.

Root cause confirmed as diagnosed on this ticket. infra/gerrit/feature-branch-inventory.sh runs `printf ... | git credential fill` under `set -o pipefail`. The test's fake git answered the credential request without consuming stdin, so it could exit before the writer's write was issued; the writer then took SIGPIPE, pipefail failed the pipeline, and the script aborted with "credential fill failed" (exit 2) for reasons unrelated to the behaviour under test. Production is unaffected because real `git credential fill` always drains its request. This is a test-fake defect, not a script defect.

Change, confined to tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py (the sole file_impact entry):

1. The stub's `credential)` arm now drains stdin (`cat >/dev/null`) before answering, so it stays alive until the writer closes and the race cannot be lost.
2. Added a deterministic regression oracle for the class, `test_credential_stub_drains_stdin_so_writer_cannot_take_sigpipe`. Delaying the writer past the point where a non-draining stub would already have exited converts the race into a fixed outcome.
3. Extracted the stub into a shared `_git_stub(calls)` helper so the oracle cannot drift from the text it guards.

Oracle validated in both directions, which is what makes it an oracle rather than another racy test. With the drain removed it fails every run at returncode 141 (128 + SIGPIPE); with the drain it passes every run. The pre-existing test is itself a race and passed even in the run where the oracle failed, so it could not have served as the regression guard on its own.

Local evidence: the focused file was run 20 consecutive times, 2 passed each run, 40 passes and 0 failures. `make lint` green, `make typecheck` green (mypy, 771 source files).

`make verify` could not be brought green on this workstation, and the cause is environmental rather than a property of this change. 52 tests fail here in multiprocessing, fcntl-lock, identity and grounding areas that this one-file test change cannot reach. Baseline established by reverting the change and re-running the same subset against an unmodified origin/main tree: identical failures. The trace bottoms out in `_multiprocessing.SemLock` raising `PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted`, i.e. the local sandbox refuses POSIX semaphore creation and that cascades. Verified in CI remains the authoritative signal for this change.

Acceptance criteria (a) fake consumes stdin and (b) deterministic regression oracle are met; (c) focused tests pass is met. (d) LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before merge is pending on 2976.
